description: Bloys van Treslongstraat 30-52 and 6-20 (BAG 1937-39): 6.1 m red-brown brick fronts of five storeys: a 3.05 m canted erker over a wide ground window on the left of the pand on storeys 1-3, one 1.25 m window on the right (pairing with the mirrored neighbour's across the party wall), a short attic row of 1.1 m windows under a thin light flat eaves at 15.0 m; paired house doors against the party wall

match.note: Treslongstraat 30-52 (BAG 1937-38, 3DBAG eaves 14.9-15.4 m, ridge = eaves: flat) and 6-20 (1938-39, eaves 15.0-15.6 m); 54-62 (1924, eaves 12.7 m) are another design

flat-slab.note: Treslongstraat 30-52 strip: a thin light slab at 14.95-15.15 m over the attic windows; flat roof

door-right.note: paired house doors (0-2.3 m) at the right party wall under a light lintel at 3.0 m, a wide 3 m ground window 0.9-2.8 m under the erker; mirrored when the strip reads the doors on the left

roof.evidence: Treslongstraat 30-52 strip: sky over the eaves slab; 3DBAG ridge = eaves 14.9-15.4 m

rhythm.bays: erker + window per pand, mirrored pairs
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: wide window + door | 1-3: erker + window | 4: 2 attic windows
rhythm.symmetry: windows and doors pair across the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: wide window, paired doors at the party wall

evidence.citation: strip.jpg at 40 px/m gridded 1 m (grid crop 1700-2700 px): erker 3.05 m wide 0.3 m off the left party wall, sills 3.95, 7.0, 9.9 m, heads 5.8, 8.9, 11.8 m, canted hood to 12.2 m; window 1.25 m; attic windows 13.0-14.55 m; ground window 0.9-2.8 m; eaves 15.0 m
